contract: P0_CLOSURE_CONTRACT.md rev 2 §3.4: the frozen Gate-2 atol/rtol on the shared fields + nc and nwfa bounds fixed before any result by the same ulp rule

derivation.method: as gate2_tolerances_PROPOSAL.md: the warm-level port/WRF input-T offset delta <= 0.015 K (Exner kappa, item 1) and the fp32 ulp, propagated one step, then x3 (Gate-2 qc: floor 5e-6 -> atol 1.5e-5)
derivation.nc: working nc = Nc*rho and the activation source ~ nwfa*rho carry delta/T <= 0.015/280 = 5.4e-5 (rho ~ 1/T); the condensation-amount floor (<= 4e-6 kg/kg, item 2) enters the one-step number flux vtnc*nc ~ nc^(1/3) rc^(2/3) with a one-step sedimented fraction <= 1e-2: (2/3)(4e-6/3e-4)(1e-2) = 9e-5; fp32 output ulp 6e-8 (+ the production-arm carry): relative floor ~1.5e-4 -> rtol 5e-4 (x3, rounded up).  atol 1 per kg covers exact-zero clear levels.  Guard: the column tool refuses any activation level within 0.15 K (10 x delta) of an activ_ncloud 10-K T-bin edge, where nc would be discontinuous in T.
derivation.nwfa: nwfa changes in one step only by the activation sink (relative noise <= 5.4e-5 of a change <= nwfa), the full-evaporation return and the surface emission nwfa2d*dt at level 1 (fp32 vs fp64 ~1e-7 of a <1e-2 fraction): relative floor ~6e-5 -> rtol 2e-4 (x3, rounded up); atol 1 per kg.
derivation.status: pre-registered with the package, before any column generation, WRF run or port output; the shared-field values are the frozen Gate-2 values unchanged; per-level discriminators (p0c_aero_column_manifest) can only ADD failures
